Welcome! I am Leonard-Allen Quaye, an Assistant Professor of Economics in the College of Business & Technology at Seattle Pacific University. This site is where I share my research on applied econometrics, time series analysis, development economics, and agribusiness, along with course materials for my students.

## What You Will Find Here

- **Research** — working papers, published work and ongoing projects
- **Teaching** — course materials, lecture notes and problem sets
- **Blog Posts** — data analysis tutorials using Python and Stata
- **Code** — reproducible econometric analysis and visualizations

Feel free to reach out at LeoAllen@spu.edu for collaborations or questions!
